g.text: One locomotive's trip through the turntable
Real run of LocomotiveDemo: L0 parked in H1 first, L1 went second (to H2), L5 grabbed the entry next.
1. L1 takes the entry, calls the table
2. The table turns to the entry
3. L1 rolls on, frees the entry
5. L1 enters H2, frees the table
Two locks, two scopes. The entry is
free from step 3, so the next loco
queues on it while L1 is still turning.
The table lock is held from appeler()
to sortir(): one loco on it at a time.
